# KodeToCareer - Complete System, Course & Program Specifications

> KodeToCareer is an ISO 9001:2015 certified career-focused tech training institute based in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India, founded in 2021 by Md Arbaaz. It provides 100% live interactive cohorts, hands-on capstone project portfolios, guaranteed internship opportunities, and dedicated 1-on-1 placement support with 500+ hiring partners.

## Core Information & Identity
- **Legal Entity**: KodeToCareer (Webot App Pvt Ltd)
- **Founded**: 2021 by Md Arbaaz (Founder & Lead Tech Instructor)
- **Accreditation**: ISO 9001:2015 Certified, NSDC Partner, Startup India Recognized
- **Placement Statistics**: 95% placement rate across 1,200+ trained graduates
- **Hiring Network**: 500+ corporate hiring partners including top MNCs, tech startups, and IT consultancies
- **Headquarters**: A-48, Basement, Sector 2, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201301, India
- **Coordinates**: Latitude 28.585943, Longitude 77.312582
- **Contact Phone**: +91 93117 24200 / +91 96679 75616
- **Contact Email**: info@kodetocareer.com

## Complete Course Catalog & Technical Syllabi

### 1. MERN Stack Development + AI Course
- **URL**: https://kodetocareer.com/courses/mern-stack-development
- **Duration**: 4 to 6 Months (Live Cohort + 15+ Capstones)
- **Credential**: ISO 9001:2015 Training Certificate
- **Core Modules**: HTML5/CSS3, JavaScript ES6+, React 19, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, RESTful APIs, Git/GitHub, AI API Integration (OpenAI/Gemini), Docker Basics, AWS Deployment, System Design.
- **Career Roles**: Full Stack Developer, Frontend Engineer, MERN Developer, React Developer.

### 2. Python Programming & Automation Course
- **URL**: https://kodetocareer.com/courses/python-programming
- **Duration**: 3 to 4 Months (Live Cohort)
- **Core Modules**: Core Python 3, Object-Oriented Programming, Data Structures & Algorithms, File I/O, Web Scraping (BeautifulSoup/Selenium), Django REST Framework, PostgreSQL, Automated Scripts.
- **Career Roles**: Python Developer, Backend Developer, Automation Engineer.

### 3. Data Science & Machine Learning Course
- **URL**: https://kodetocareer.com/courses/data-science-machine-learning
- **Duration**: 6 Months (Live Cohort + Capstone Projects)
- **Core Modules**: Python for Data Science, NumPy, Pandas, SQL & Database Querying, Data Visualization (Matplotlib, Seaborn), Machine Learning Algorithms (Scikit-Learn), Deep Learning (TensorFlow/PyTorch), Power BI, Generative AI & Prompt Engineering.
- **Career Roles**: Data Scientist, ML Engineer, Data Analyst, AI Specialist.

### 4. Data Analytics & BI Training Program
- **URL**: https://kodetocareer.com/courses/data-analytics
- **Duration**: 3 to 4 Months (Live Cohort)
- **Core Modules**: Advanced Excel (VBA, Power Query), Complex SQL Queries, Power BI Dashboarding, Tableau Visualization, Python Predictive Analytics, Business Intelligence Workflows.
- **Career Roles**: Data Analyst, Business Intelligence Analyst, Reporting Engineer.

### 5. Java Full Stack & Spring Boot Course
- **URL**: https://kodetocareer.com/courses/java-full-stack
- **Duration**: 5 to 6 Months (Live Cohort)
- **Core Modules**: Core Java 21, Data Structures, Spring Boot 3, Hibernate ORM, Microservices Architecture, PostgreSQL, React Frontend Integration, Maven, Docker.
- **Career Roles**: Java Developer, Backend Software Engineer, Java Full Stack Developer.

### 6. Cloud Computing & DevOps Engineering
- **URL**: https://kodetocareer.com/courses/cloud-devops
- **Duration**: 4 to 5 Months (Live Cohort)
- **Core Modules**: Linux Administration, AWS Core Services (EC2, S3, IAM, VPC), Docker Containerization, Kubernetes Orchestration, Jenkins CI/CD Pipelines, Terraform Infrastructure as Code.
- **Career Roles**: DevOps Engineer, Cloud Engineer, Infrastructure Specialist.

### 7. UI/UX & Graphic Product Design Course
- **URL**: https://kodetocareer.com/courses/graphic-design-ui-ux
- **Duration**: 3 to 4 Months (Live Cohort)
- **Core Modules**: Figma Prototyping, Wireframing, User Research, Design Systems, Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, Visual Hierarchy, Micro-interactions.
- **Career Roles**: UI/UX Designer, Product Designer, Graphic Designer.

### 8. MLOps & AI Systems Engineering Course
- **URL**: https://kodetocareer.com/courses/mlops-ai-systems
- **Duration**: 4 Months (Live Cohort)
- **Core Modules**: Triton Inference Server, vLLM Optimization, MLflow Pipelines, Model Monitoring & Drift Detection, GPU Cluster Management, Docker & Kubernetes for ML.
- **Career Roles**: MLOps Engineer, AI Systems Architect, LLM Infrastructure Engineer.

## Key Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

### What makes KodeToCareer different from traditional coding bootcamps?
KodeToCareer offers 100% live interactive cohorts led by senior tech mentors, hands-on capstone projects integrated with AI toolsets, guaranteed internship opportunities, ISO 9001:2015 certification, and a 95% placement rate across 500+ hiring partners.

### Are KodeToCareer certificates ISO accredited?
Yes, all certificates issued by KodeToCareer are accredited under ISO 9001:2015 quality standards and can be verified online instantly.

### Does KodeToCareer offer online classes across India?
Yes, KodeToCareer provides 100% live online interactive cohorts accessible from anywhere in India, as well as physical training centers in Noida, Uttar Pradesh.
